title: Sticky Pineapple Slice
description: A crispy cobbler-style cake inspired by the film Steel Magnolias. Self-raising flour, caster sugar and tinned pineapple combine into a sticky, caramelised loaf.

ingredients.text: 1 x 432g tin of pineapple in syrup or juice

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line a standard loaf tin.
Sift the flour into a bowl and add the sugar.
Hold back one ring or a couple of chunks of pineapple from the tin. Mash the remaining pineapple in its syrup or juice and add to the flour and sugar mixture. Mix well.
Pour into the loaf tin (it will be very liquid) and bake for 60 minutes, until golden brown and a skewer comes out clean.
Turn out on to a wire rack. Decorate with the leftover pineapple before serving.
notes: Serves 10. Can also bake in a 20cm round tin for the same time. Try with tinned peaches or pears.
